kind: multi-owner basis vector, observation-window consistency and as-of semantics

recordedPositions: Reasoning (per referenced cell): {throughSeq, chainDigest, frontierRevision, frontierDigest}
basisVector.absentOwnerNeverEmptyHistory: G-N12: an uncomposed proof owner yields availability NOT_COMPOSED and completeness INCOMPLETE, never an empty-but-successful history

observationWindowConsistency.protocol: read basis -> read history -> read basis -> compare
observationWindowConsistency.racedDetection: G-N11: a Work history that advances between the reads marks the window RACED and the read model states it as a caveat

currentness.measured: G-N13: an owner WITHOUT currentness semantics that reports STALE is recorded as UNKNOWN rather than believed; an owner WITH them (reasoning frontier, proof standing) reports its own verdict

asOfSemantics.futureEventsExcluded: G-N14: a cut at sequence 3 contains event ids [1,2,3] and no PROJECT_REVISED node
guarantees: the named cut is the cut projected
a historical fact keeps the authorization, context and world basis it actually had
a rebuild of the same cut yields the same semantic digest
doesNotGuarantee: a globally atomic snapshot across owners
that an owner history is quiescent during the projection (the window may be RACED)
that a projected fact is still current — currentness is reported separately
